claims.statement: For the explicit 10-component systematic field-cube product over binary modulus X^100+X^29+X^23+X^16+1, with the radius-14 systematic candidate decoder in proof.md for each component, the uniform-message average block error for 1000 information bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 1888305552786479/2000000000000000.
The bsc-ops-v1 program for the same field-cube product and its same component decoder uses at most the integer W=448951539095729003290 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(34303/500).

experiments.purpose: Verify the field modulus, exact component occupancy and combined block-error bound, memory and integer exponent inequality, and sample window-arithmetic identities.
